topic.title: Cold Plate Thickness and all-core Turbo Thermal Response

fig.title: Transient Tsn all-core Turbo Example: 15W TDP Package

note.p: 1 Analysis assumes fan running at full speed and maximum operating temperature. These curves are exemplary and are not intended to represent any one Intel product.
2 It may be difficult to achieve a low bond line thickness (BLT) with 0.25mm cold plates, and that complexity is not comprehended in this sensitivity study.

body.p: Increasing the thickness of the cold plate can significantly increase the time that the processor can operate in full turbo power (PL2) prior to reaching maximum operating temperature. This additional headroom can also be used to increase PL2 power for a targeted duration (Power Capability) to optimize for specific workloads. Intel recommends full PL2 power support for ≥ 3 to 5 seconds to meet target performance for representative bursty workloads.
